items.headline:
BREAKING: The Bank of Japan raises interest rates by 25 basis points to the highest level since 1995 due to elevated inflation.

After the rate hike in June, this marked the shortest interval between rate increases in Japan since 1990.

The global rate hike cycle has arrived.
